_comment: Jeu figé fictif pour l'acrylonitrile (CAS de test 107-13-1). Entreprises et événements inventés (Gulfchem, Calderon) : rien ne décrit une entreprise réelle. Sert à « goulot dev record-watch » puis au rejeu des tests. Depuis le 4 novembre 2026, les articles sont servis comme un flux de média avec résumé : un titre seul n'entre plus dans le tri. Les réponses IA enregistrées l'ont été sur les titres seuls.

articles.title: Fire shuts Gulfchem acrylonitrile plant in Texas, restart seen weeks away
articles.summary: A fire broke out on Friday at Gulfchem's acrylonitrile unit on the Texas Gulf Coast. The company said nobody was hurt and that the restart would take several weeks while damaged equipment is replaced.

articles.title: Gulfchem declares force majeure on US acrylonitrile after Calderon site blaze
articles.summary: Gulfchem notified customers of force majeure on acrylonitrile deliveries from its Calderon site after the blaze, and said it would allocate remaining volumes from inventory.

articles.title: Massive blast wipes out acrylonitrile capacity across Asia, insiders say
articles.summary: Anonymous posts claim one blast removed most Asian acrylonitrile capacity; no company, place or authority is named.

articles.title: Acrylonitrile shortage: every Asian plant reportedly offline after explosion
articles.summary: A forum thread says all acrylonitrile plants in Asia are offline after an explosion, without naming any site or source.

articles.title: Unconfirmed: acrylonitrile units in China and Korea destroyed, traders panic
articles.summary: Traders on social media relay unverified claims that units in China and Korea were destroyed; no producer confirms.

articles.title: Acrylonitrile : les prix restent stables en attendant les contrats du quatrième trimestre
articles.summary: Les prix contractuels de l'acrylonitrile restent stables avant les négociations du quatrième trimestre, selon des acheteurs interrogés.

articles.title: Acrylic knitwear is back for 2027: why acrylonitrile-based yarns feel softer
articles.summary: Fashion brands bring back acrylic knitwear; designers explain why yarns made from acrylonitrile-based fibres feel softer.

federal_register.title: Acrylonitrile From the Republic of Korea: Preliminary Affirmative Antidumping Determination
federal_register.abstract: The Department of Commerce preliminarily determines that acrylonitrile from Korea is sold at less than fair value (HTS 2926.10.00).
